checks.explanation: Canonical mixed radical must be accepted.
The same coefficient and radical in reversed factor order remain equivalent; an unmet presentation preference is not a mathematical error.
8b^6a^3 is the same simplified product as 8a^3b^6.
A rational coefficient is equivalent to a single quotient.
27/8 equals exactly 3.375; the prompt only requests evaluation.
The positive-exponent reciprocal error must be rejected.
The minus symbol supplied by the input toolbar must have a supported, consistent interpretation.
This proposed acceptance condition requires adequate new supply or honest repeat labelling. The current eight-item bank cannot supply two disjoint five-item sets.
The learner page promises all 32 targets across two balanced sets; coverage must be measured over target IDs.
